'''Ravis''' was a fictional individual created by [[Shada D'ukal]] <ref name="Specter">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].<ref name="DateSotP">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Specter of the Past]]'' to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ravis was mentioned in the novel ''[[Specter of the Past]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[1997]] as part one of the ''[[Star Wars: The Hand of Thrawn Duology]]''.<ref name="Specter" />
